Whistle Blowing policy (continued)
• In the reasonable belief of the individual making
the disclosure that it tends to show malpractice or
impropriety and if they make the disclosure to an
appropriate person. The policy makes it clear “any form
of reprisal against anyone who in good faith has raised
a concern is forbidden and will itself be regarded as a
serious offence to be dealt with under the Disciplinary
Procedure.”
The ethics hotline is managed by an independent,
accredited and external institution. Whistle blowing
statistics are reported to the Board Audit and Risk
Committee.
